description: This file defines a React component 'BookList' that renders a list of books with sorting and filtering capabilities. It manages book data, sorts by various properties, filters based on search text, and provides UI elements for each book item with navigational links.

classes.name: BookList
classes.description: React component class for displaying and sorting a list of books, with internal state managing the book data and search text.

methods.name: filterBooks
methods.description: Filters the list of books based on the search text.

methods.name: sortBooks
methods.description: Sorts the books array based on current sorting configurations.

methods.name: sortBy
methods.description: Handles user action to change sorting configuration for a given property.
